input.content:
# InkOS — Production Bug-Fix Sprint Plan

## Context

After merging S18 (PRs #4 + #5), production is broken. User reports from live screenshots:

| Page | Symptom |
|---|---|
| `/calendar` | "Couldn't load appointments" red banner |
| `/projects` | "Something went wrong — Server Components render" |
| `/clients` | "Something went wrong — Server Components render" |
| `/artists` (Team) | "Something went wrong — Server Components render" |
| `/payments` | "Something went wrong — Server Components render" |
| `/portfolio` (Flash & Portfolio) | Stub: "Coming in Sprint S18" — never replaced |
| Sidebar Inventory/Analytics/AI/Marketing | Clicking redirects to `/settings/billing` instead of the page |
| Bottom profile block | Just a gear icon link — no dropdown menu |

**User intent (verbatim):**
> "many pages still not working when we click on it — like when click on inventory its opening setting page when click analystic page still same thing — for now dont block all page by studio and all just keep badge later we will restrcit — ai and marketing also fix — and bottom profile lets make properly so when we click on it properly its open dropdown properly there and have perfect menu there — lets devide by sprint and deep plan to ensure its fully working without single bug"

## Root-cause diagnosis (from 3 parallel Explore agents)

### Root Cause 1 — Prod DB is missing the S18 migrations

All 5 crashing pages + Calendar share ONE root cause: **production Supabase hasn't applied the migrations that shipped in PR #4 + #5**. The code/types reference tables + columns that don't exist yet in prod.

Specifically missing in prod:
- `projects`, `project_references`, `project_progress_photos` tables
- `bookings.project_id`, `bookings.session_number` columns
- `bookings.reminder_12h_sent_at`, `bookings.reminder_4h_sent_at`, `bookings.deposit_deadline_override`
- `conversations` table + `client_communications.conversation_id` column
- `inbox_assignments` table
- `studios.twilio_phone_number`, `studios.deposit_deadline_hours`
- `flash_events`, `flash_event_designs`, `flash_event_slots`
- `artists.slug`

Evidence: `/api/bookings/route.ts` selects `deposit_cents, deposit_paid, project_id, session_number` — if `project_id` column doesn't exist in prod, PostgREST returns 500 → Calendar shows "Couldn't load appointments."

### Root Cause 2 — Sidebar hard-redirects on `requiredPlan` gate

`components/app/sidebar/SidebarNavGroup.tsx` lines 76–82 redirect to `/settings/billing` when an item has a `requiredPlan` that exceeds the user's current plan. That's why clicking Inventory/Analytics/AI/Marketing opens Settings instead of the page.

User wants: badge stays visible as a marker, but clicking navigates to the actual page. No plan blocking at all (for now). Future restriction is explicitly deferred.

Pages that currently self-gate with `UpgradeGatePageBlock` (Inventory, Marketing) also need their gate removed per user instruction.

### Root Cause 3 — `SidebarUserFooter` is not a dropdown

`components/app/sidebar/SidebarUserFooter.tsx` is a static row with avatar + name + role + gear→`/settings`. There is no clickable dropdown. Meanwhile `AppHeader.tsx` lines 331–423 already has a full working dropdown (Profile / Settings / Theme submenu / Sign out) — **reuse this exact pattern** in the footer.

### Root Cause 4 — `/portfolio` is a "Coming Soon" stub from S18

The Flash & Portfolio sidebar item points to a page that still displays "Coming in Sprint S18." It was never replaced with real content.

---

## Sprint plan (4 sprints, ordered by blast radius)

## Sprint 1 — Unblock production (DB migrations)

**Goal:** Apply all S18 migrations to prod Supabase so the 5 crashing pages and Calendar work.

**Why first:** Every page crash is downstream of this. No UI fix matters until DB is aligned.

**Approach:**
1. Identify the exact migration files that haven't been deployed:
   - `20260417*` — pre-S18 status history, calendar indexes, guest artist perms, client views (check if applied)
   - `20260420120000_projects.sql`
   - `20260420130000_projects_storage.sql`
   - `20260421100000_messaging_conversations.sql`
   - `20260421110000_studios_twilio_phone.sql`
   - `20260421200000_booking_deposit_reminders.sql`
   - `20260421210000_studio_deposit_deadline.sql`
   - `20260421300000_inbox_assignments.sql`
   - `20260422100000_flash_events.sql`
   - `20260422200000_artists_slug.sql`

2. Run migrations via Supabase CLI against the PROD project:
   ```bash
   supabase link --project-ref <PROD_REF>
   supabase db push
   ```
   (OR manual SQL via dashboard if the CLI isn't linked)

3. Create 3 Supabase Storage buckets (private):
   - `project-references`
   - `project-photos`
   - `flash-event-assets`

4. Verification per page:
   - `/calendar` loads today's bookings (no red banner)
   - `/projects` renders the empty-state or list (no crash)
   - `/clients` renders the client list
   - `/artists` (Team) renders roster tab
   - `/payments` renders Transactions tab
   - `/inbox` renders signals list
   - `/messages` renders empty thread list
   - `/flash-events` renders empty list

5. Sanity SQL (run in Supabase SQL editor before declaring done):
   ```sql
   select table_name from information_schema.tables
   where table_schema='public'
     and table_name in ('projects','conversations','inbox_assignments',
                        'flash_events','flash_event_designs','flash_event_slots',
                        'project_references','project_progress_photos');
   -- Expect 8 rows

   select column_name from information_schema.columns
   where table_name='bookings'
     and column_name in ('project_id','session_number',
                         'reminder_12h_sent_at','reminder_4h_sent_at',
                         'deposit_deadline_override');
   -- Expect 5 rows

   select column_name from information_schema.columns
   where table_name='studios'
     and column_name in ('twilio_phone_number','deposit_deadline_hours');
   -- Expect 2 rows
   ```

**Owner:** Me + Yash (Yash runs the Supabase CLI / dashboard; I verify via code)

**Deliverable:** All 6 pages load without error in prod.

**Exit criteria:** Sanity SQL returns the expected rows AND all 6 pages load manually.

---

## Sprint 2 — Remove plan-gating redirects (keep badges visual)

**Goal:** Clicking any sidebar item navigates to its actual page. Badges stay as visual indicators only. No page-level redirects to billing.

**Files to change:**

### 2.1 — `components/app/sidebar/SidebarNavGroup.tsx`
Remove the `isGated` redirect branch at lines 76–82. Always navigate to `item.href`. Also drop the `isGated ? <button /> : <Link />` switch on line 87 — always render `<Link>`. Keep the badge visible so the Studio/Pro pill still renders as a hint.

Current behavior:
```ts
function handleClick() {
  if (isGated) { router.push('/settings/billing'); return }
  router.push(item.href)
}
render={isGated ? <button type="button" /> : <Link href={item.href} prefetch />}
```

New behavior:
```ts
function handleClick() { router.push(item.href) }
render={<Link href={item.href} prefetch />}
```

### 2.2 — `app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx`
Remove the `if (!hasFeature(plan, 'inventory')) return <UpgradeGatePageBlock />` block. Render inventory content unconditionally.

### 2.3 — `app/(app)/marketing/page.tsx`
Same — remove the `checkFeatureRpc` server-side gate + `UpgradeGatePageBlock` render.

### 2.4 — `app/(app)/reports/*` Analytics pages
These don't have server-side gates currently — confirm they don't redirect elsewhere. If `/reports/page.tsx` redirects to `/reports/revenue`, make sure that page renders.

### 2.5 — `app/(app)/ai-design/page.tsx`
Currently no server-side gate — confirm. If any `<UpgradeGate>` wraps sections, leave them inline (those are fine — they don't redirect; they render content beside an upgrade hint).

### 2.6 — `app/(app)/flash-events/page.tsx`
Currently no server-side gate — confirm renders.

**What stays:**
- `requiredPlan` + `featureKey` fields on nav items → still drive badge rendering (the "STUDIO" / "PRO" pill you see in the sidebar)
- In-feature contextual upgrade hints (e.g., a disabled button with a "Pro feature" tooltip inside a Studio-plan page) — acceptable; only hard page-level redirects go away

**Owner:** Me (one-shot edit; ≤6 files)

**Exit criteria:**
- Click Inventory on a Solo plan → page loads (with or without data). Does not navigate to `/settings/billing`.
- Click AI on a Studio plan → AI Design Hub renders.
- Click Analytics on a Studio plan → Reports landing or revenue tab renders.
- Click Marketing on a Solo plan → Marketing page renders.
- Click Flash Events → flash events list renders.
- `pnpm typecheck` + `pnpm build` clean.

---

## Sprint 3 — Build the sidebar profile dropdown

**Goal:** The bottom-of-sidebar profile row becomes a proper dropdown with a complete menu.

**Reference:** `components/app/sidebar/AppHeader.tsx` lines 331–423 — already has a working top-right user dropdown. Reuse the exact shadcn `DropdownMenu` / `DropdownMenuSub` / `DropdownMenuItem` pattern.

### 3.1 — Rewrite `components/app/sidebar/SidebarUserFooter.tsx`

New structure:
- **Trigger:** the existing avatar + name + role row becomes a `<DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>`. Removes the static link. Gear icon collapses into the dropdown's own Settings item. Hover state + active-on-open highlight to signal it's clickable.
- **Dropdown content** (opens above the trigger — `side="top" align="start"`):

  **Header (non-clickable label)**
  - Large avatar + full name + email + role chip (mirrors AppHeader)

  **Account section**
  - My profile → `/settings/account/profile`
  - Advanced (data export / deletion) → `/settings/account/advanced`

  **Workspace section** (owner/admin only — hide for artist/receptionist/guest_artist)
  - Studio settings → `/settings/studio/profile`
  - Team & members → `/settings/team/members`
  - Billing & plan → `/settings/subscription/billing` (with plan badge)
  - Integrations → `/settings/integrations`

  **Appearance submenu** (`DropdownMenuSub`)
  - Light / Dark / System (reuse AppHeader theme switcher logic via `next-themes`)

  **Help** (optional — can skip for v1)
  - Keyboard shortcuts modal
  - Docs / support link

  **Sign out** (destructive, red text, bottom)
  - `await supabase.auth.signOut(); router.push('/login'); router.refresh()` — same impl as AppHeader

### 3.2 — Collapsed-state behavior

When sidebar is icon-only (collapsed):
- Trigger shrinks to just the avatar
- Dropdown content still renders full menu on open
- `side="right"` when collapsed (so menu opens outside the narrow rail); `side="top"` when expanded

### 3.3 — Role-based visibility

Reuse the existing `role: NavRole` prop that `AppSidebar` already passes down. Only show Workspace section if role is `owner` or `admin`. Artist/receptionist/guest_artist see Account + Appearance + Sign out only.

### 3.4 — Shared header dropdown consistency

AppHeader has a similar user dropdown. Option: extract the common menu into `components/shared/UserMenuDropdown.tsx` and use from both places. **For v1, don't extract** — just duplicate the pattern to keep the sprint small and avoid regressions in AppHeader.

**Files:**
- Modify: `components/app/sidebar/SidebarUserFooter.tsx` (full rewrite, ~150 lines)
- Maybe modify: `components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar.tsx` (pass role prop if not already)
- No new components unless extraction is requested

**Exit criteria:**
- Click the bottom profile block → dropdown opens above it, anchored left-aligned
- Menu shows: Account / Workspace (for owner) / Appearance submenu / Sign out
- Each menu item navigates to the correct route
- Sign out actually logs out and redirects to `/login`
- Theme switcher changes theme immediately
- Works in both expanded and collapsed (icon-only) sidebar states
- `pnpm typecheck` + `pnpm build` clean

---

## Sprint 4 — Ship Flash & Portfolio + full smoke test

### 4.1 — Replace the "Coming in Sprint S18" stub

`app/(app)/portfolio/page.tsx` currently renders a placeholder "Coming in Sprint S18." Replace with a minimal-viable portfolio hub:

- **Tabs:** Flash sheets · Portfolio photos · Artist galleries
- **Flash sheets tab:** grid of uploaded flash sheets (reuses storage bucket pattern from flash-events), upload form, "mark as sold" toggle, export PDF
- **Portfolio photos tab:** grid of portfolio photos grouped by artist, upload form, set cover image
- **Artist galleries tab:** per-artist public gallery URLs (reuses the `artists.slug` field added in S18), copy-link button, toggle visibility

If time-constrained, scope this to **Portfolio photos only** (simplest) and keep Flash sheets + Galleries as v2 scope within the tab with a compact "coming soon" inside just that tab.

**New schema (if any):**
- `portfolio_photos` table (studio_id, artist_id, storage_path, caption, cover, display_order, created_at) + RLS + updated_at
- Optional: `flash_sheets` table (studio_id, artist_id, title, storage_path, price_cents, sold, created_at) + RLS

**Alternative:** if the user is fine keeping this as-is for v2, **skip Sprint 4.1 and just update the stub copy** to be more polished and add a "Return to Today" button.

### 4.2 — Full smoke test pass

Click through every sidebar item as owner, then as a demo artist, then receptionist, then guest_artist. Document any page that throws, 404s, or misroutes. Fix any regressions.

# InkOS — Production Bug-Fix Sprint Plan

## Context

After merging S18 (PRs #4 + #5), production is broken. User reports from live screenshots:

| Page | Symptom |
|---|---|
| `/calendar` | "Couldn't load appointments" red banner |
| `/projects` | "Something went wrong — Server Components render" |
| `/clients` | "Something went wrong — Server Components render" |
| `/artists` (Team) | "Something went wrong — Server Components render" |
| `/payments` | "Something went wrong — Server Components render" |
| `/portfolio` (Flash & Portfolio) | Stub: "Coming in Sprint S18" — never replaced |
| Sidebar Inventory/Analytics/AI/Marketing | Clicking redirects to `/settings/billing` instead of the page |
| Bottom profile block | Just a gear icon link — no dropdown menu |

**User intent (verbatim):**
> "many pages still not working when we click on it — like when click on inventory its opening setting page when click analystic page still same thing — for now dont block all page by studio and all just keep badge later we will restrcit — ai and marketing also fix — and bottom profile lets make properly so when we click on it properly its open dropdown properly there and have perfect menu there — lets devide by sprint and deep plan to ensure its fully working without single bug"

## Root-cause diagnosis (from 3 parallel Explore agents)

### Root Cause 1 — Prod DB is missing the S18 migrations

All 5 crashing pages + Calendar share ONE root cause: **production Supabase hasn't applied the migrations that shipped in PR #4 + #5**. The code/types reference tables + columns that don't exist yet in prod.

Specifically missing in prod:
- `projects`, `project_references`, `project_progress_photos` tables
- `bookings.project_id`, `bookings.session_number` columns
- `bookings.reminder_12h_sent_at`, `bookings.reminder_4h_sent_at`, `bookings.deposit_deadline_override`
- `conversations` table + `client_communications.conversation_id` column
- `inbox_assignments` table
- `studios.twilio_phone_number`, `studios.deposit_deadline_hours`
- `flash_events`, `flash_event_designs`, `flash_event_slots`
- `artists.slug`

Evidence: `/api/bookings/route.ts` selects `deposit_cents, deposit_paid, project_id, session_number` — if `project_id` column doesn't exist in prod, PostgREST returns 500 → Calendar shows "Couldn't load appointments."

### Root Cause 2 — Sidebar hard-redirects on `requiredPlan` gate

`components/app/sidebar/SidebarNavGroup.tsx` lines 76–82 redirect to `/settings/billing` when an item has a `requiredPlan` that exceeds the user's current plan. That's why clicking Inventory/Analytics/AI/Marketing opens Settings instead of the page.

User wants: badge stays visible as a marker, but clicking navigates to the actual page. No plan blocking at all (for now). Future restriction is explicitly deferred.

Pages that currently self-gate with `UpgradeGatePageBlock` (Inventory, Marketing) also need their gate removed per user instruction.

### Root Cause 3 — `SidebarUserFooter` is not a dropdown

`components/app/sidebar/SidebarUserFooter.tsx` is a static row with avatar + name + role + gear→`/settings`. There is no clickable dropdown. Meanwhile `AppHeader.tsx` lines 331–423 already has a full working dropdown (Profile / Settings / Theme submenu / Sign out) — **reuse this exact pattern** in the footer.

### Root Cause 4 — `/portfolio` is a "Coming Soon" stub from S18

The Flash & Portfolio sidebar item points to a page that still displays "Coming in Sprint S18." It was never replaced with real content.

---

## Sprint plan (4 sprints, ordered by blast radius)

## Sprint 1 — Unblock production (DB migrations)

**Goal:** Apply all S18 migrations to prod Supabase so the 5 crashing pages and Calendar work.

**Why first:** Every page crash is downstream of this. No UI fix matters until DB is aligned.

**Approach:**
1. Identify the exact migration files that haven't been deployed:
   - `20260417*` — pre-S18 status history, calendar indexes, guest artist perms, client views (check if applied)
   - `20260420120000_projects.sql`
   - `20260420130000_projects_storage.sql`
   - `20260421100000_messaging_conversations.sql`
   - `20260421110000_studios_twilio_phone.sql`
   - `20260421200000_booking_deposit_reminders.sql`
   - `20260421210000_studio_deposit_deadline.sql`
   - `20260421300000_inbox_assignments.sql`
   - `20260422100000_flash_events.sql`
   - `20260422200000_artists_slug.sql`

2. Run migrations via Supabase CLI against the PROD project:
   ```bash
   supabase link --project-ref <PROD_REF>
   supabase db push
   ```
   (OR manual SQL via dashboard if the CLI isn't linked)

3. Create 3 Supabase Storage buckets (private):
   - `project-references`
   - `project-photos`
   - `flash-event-assets`

4. Verification per page:
   - `/calendar` loads today's bookings (no red banner)
   - `/projects` renders the empty-state or list (no crash)
   - `/clients` renders the client list
   - `/artists` (Team) renders roster tab
   - `/payments` renders Transactions tab
   - `/inbox` renders signals list
   - `/messages` renders empty thread list
   - `/flash-events` renders empty list

5. Sanity SQL (run in Supabase SQL editor before declaring done):
   ```sql
   select table_name from information_schema.tables
   where table_schema='public'
     and table_name in ('projects','conversations','inbox_assignments',
                        'flash_events','flash_event_designs','flash_event_slots',
                        'project_references','project_progress_photos');
   -- Expect 8 rows

   select column_name from information_schema.columns
   where table_name='bookings'
     and column_name in ('project_id','session_number',
                         'reminder_12h_sent_at','reminder_4h_sent_at',
                         'deposit_deadline_override');
   -- Expect 5 rows

   select column_name from information_schema.columns
   where table_name='studios'
     and column_name in ('twilio_phone_number','deposit_deadline_hours');
   -- Expect 2 rows
   ```

**Owner:** Me + Yash (Yash runs the Supabase CLI / dashboard; I verify via code)

**Deliverable:** All 6 pages load without error in prod.

**Exit criteria:** Sanity SQL returns the expected rows AND all 6 pages load manually.

---

## Sprint 2 — Remove plan-gating redirects (keep badges visual)

**Goal:** Clicking any sidebar item navigates to its actual page. Badges stay as visual indicators only. No page-level redirects to billing.

**Files to change:**

### 2.1 — `components/app/sidebar/SidebarNavGroup.tsx`
Remove the `isGated` redirect branch at lines 76–82. Always navigate to `item.href`. Also drop the `isGated ? <button /> : <Link />` switch on line 87 — always render `<Link>`. Keep the badge visible so the Studio/Pro pill still renders as a hint.

Current behavior:
```ts
function handleClick() {
  if (isGated) { router.push('/settings/billing'); return }
  router.push(item.href)
}
render={isGated ? <button type="button" /> : <Link href={item.href} prefetch />}
```

New behavior:
```ts
function handleClick() { router.push(item.href) }
render={<Link href={item.href} prefetch />}
```

### 2.2 — `app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx`
Remove the `if (!hasFeature(plan, 'inventory')) return <UpgradeGatePageBlock />` block. Render inventory content unconditionally.

### 2.3 — `app/(app)/marketing/page.tsx`
Same — remove the `checkFeatureRpc` server-side gate + `UpgradeGatePageBlock` render.

### 2.4 — `app/(app)/reports/*` Analytics pages
These don't have server-side gates currently — confirm they don't redirect elsewhere. If `/reports/page.tsx` redirects to `/reports/revenue`, make sure that page renders.

### 2.5 — `app/(app)/ai-design/page.tsx`
Currently no server-side gate — confirm. If any `<UpgradeGate>` wraps sections, leave them inline (those are fine — they don't redirect; they render content beside an upgrade hint).

### 2.6 — `app/(app)/flash-events/page.tsx`
Currently no server-side gate — confirm renders.

**What stays:**
- `requiredPlan` + `featureKey` fields on nav items → still drive badge rendering (the "STUDIO" / "PRO" pill you see in the sidebar)
- In-feature contextual upgrade hints (e.g., a disabled button with a "Pro feature" tooltip inside a Studio-plan page) — acceptable; only hard page-level redirects go away

**Owner:** Me (one-shot edit; ≤6 files)

**Exit criteria:**
- Click Inventory on a Solo plan → page loads (with or without data). Does not navigate to `/settings/billing`.
- Click AI on a Studio plan → AI Design Hub renders.
- Click Analytics on a Studio plan → Reports landing or revenue tab renders.
- Click Marketing on a Solo plan → Marketing page renders.
- Click Flash Events → flash events list renders.
- `pnpm typecheck` + `pnpm build` clean.

---

## Sprint 3 — Build the sidebar profile dropdown

**Goal:** The bottom-of-sidebar profile row becomes a proper dropdown with a complete menu.

**Reference:** `components/app/sidebar/AppHeader.tsx` lines 331–423 — already has a working top-right user dropdown. Reuse the exact shadcn `DropdownMenu` / `DropdownMenuSub` / `DropdownMenuItem` pattern.

### 3.1 — Rewrite `components/app/sidebar/SidebarUserFooter.tsx`

New structure:
- **Trigger:** the existing avatar + name + role row becomes a `<DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>`. Removes the static link. Gear icon collapses into the dropdown's own Settings item. Hover state + active-on-open highlight to signal it's clickable.
- **Dropdown content** (opens above the trigger — `side="top" align="start"`):

  **Header (non-clickable label)**
  - Large avatar + full name + email + role chip (mirrors AppHeader)

  **Account section**
  - My profile → `/settings/account/profile`
  - Advanced (data export / deletion) → `/settings/account/advanced`

  **Workspace section** (owner/admin only — hide for artist/receptionist/guest_artist)
  - Studio settings → `/settings/studio/profile`
  - Team & members → `/settings/team/members`
  - Billing & plan → `/settings/subscription/billing` (with plan badge)
  - Integrations → `/settings/integrations`

  **Appearance submenu** (`DropdownMenuSub`)
  - Light / Dark / System (reuse AppHeader theme switcher logic via `next-themes`)

  **Help** (optional — can skip for v1)
  - Keyboard shortcuts modal
  - Docs / support link

  **Sign out** (destructive, red text, bottom)
  - `await supabase.auth.signOut(); router.push('/login'); router.refresh()` — same impl as AppHeader

### 3.2 — Collapsed-state behavior

When sidebar is icon-only (collapsed):
- Trigger shrinks to just the avatar
- Dropdown content still renders full menu on open
- `side="right"` when collapsed (so menu opens outside the narrow rail); `side="top"` when expanded

### 3.3 — Role-based visibility

Reuse the existing `role: NavRole` prop that `AppSidebar` already passes down. Only show Workspace section if role is `owner` or `admin`. Artist/receptionist/guest_artist see Account + Appearance + Sign out only.

### 3.4 — Shared header dropdown consistency

AppHeader has a similar user dropdown. Option: extract the common menu into `components/shared/UserMenuDropdown.tsx` and use from both places. **For v1, don't extract** — just duplicate the pattern to keep the sprint small and avoid regressions in AppHeader.

- Each menu item navigates to the correct route
- Sign out actually logs out and redirects to `/login`
- Theme switcher changes theme immediately
- Works in both expanded and collapsed (icon-only) sidebar states
- `pnpm typecheck` + `pnpm build` clean

input.plan:
# InkOS — Competitor-Informed Implementation Plan (6 Core Functions)

## Context

User provided a 32-page competitor research PDF covering 9 rivals (DaySmart, Tattoo Studio Pro, TattooGenda, TattooPro.io, TattooClient, Venue Ink, Zylu, InkDesk, GlossGenius) across 6 sidebar functions: **Today, Inbox, Calendar, Messages, Appointment, Projects**. Goal: deep-dive check against current InkOS state, then implement each function pixel-perfect with competitor-informed patterns baked in.

**Outcome:** Close the 3 confirmed gaps (Projects greenfield, Messages stub, auto-cancel cron), layer premium UX enhancements on the 3 already-shipped functions (Today, Inbox, Calendar), and end with a product that beats TattooGenda on projects, matches TattooClient on unified messaging, and outshines GlossGenius on polish.

---

## Current-State Audit (from 3 parallel Explore agents)

| Function | Route | Status | Gap vs. competitors |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Today** | `app/(app)/today/page.tsx` | ✅ Full — KPIs, agenda, activity feed, inventory alerts | Missing TSP-style "Queue" check-in row + role-aware owner/artist/reception variants |
| **Inbox** | `app/(app)/inbox/page.tsx` | ✅ Full — 4 signals (deposits, forms, clients, waitlist) | Missing Linear-grade urgency grouping + one-click resolve actions |
| **Calendar** | `app/(app)/calendar/page.tsx` | ✅ Full — FullCalendar, multi-artist, drag-reschedule, filters | Missing **visible red/green deposit dots** + guest-artist horizontal bars |
| **Messages** | `app/(app)/messages/page.tsx` | ⚠️ **STUB** — `MessagesComingSoon` component only | `client_communications` table + Resend wired; needs full thread UI + SMS send + Realtime |
| **Appointment** | `app/(app)/appointments/*` + `/book/[studioSlug]` | ✅ Full — Dodo deposits, intake forms, public flow | Missing **auto-cancel cron** for unpaid deposits + booking-link hub + QR code |
| **Projects** | **No route, no table** | ❌ **GREENFIELD** | Biggest moat — TattooGenda is the only competitor with projects, and their UI is 2015-era |

---

## Build Priority (Moat × Gap)

1. **Projects** — greenfield, biggest moat (TattooGenda's only native feature, poorly executed)
2. **Messages** — infrastructure is 50% done (`client_communications` table + Resend + SMS templates exist); ship the UI + send logic
3. **Auto-cancel cron** — critical missing piece on Appointment flow (TattooPro.io ships this)
4. **Calendar deposit dots + guest bars** — visual polish to match TattooGenda's tattoo-native UX
5. **Today "Queue" widget + role-aware variants** — copy TSP's pattern, apply GlossGenius polish
6. **Inbox urgency grouping + AI triage** — Linear-grade triage that no tattoo competitor has

---

## PHASE A — Critical Gaps (greenfield / stubbed)

### A1. Projects (multi-session tattoos) — biggest moat

**Competitor pattern (TattooGenda):** one Project = N Sessions, shared deposit pool, linked appointments, stored references, session remaining counter. Their UI is dated; InkOS can leapfrog.

**Data model** — new migration `supabase/migrations/20260420_projects.sql`:
```sql
create table projects (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  studio_id uuid not null references studios(id) on delete cascade,
  client_id uuid not null references clients(id) on delete cascade,
  primary_artist_id uuid references artists(id) on delete set null,
  name text not null,                    -- "Dragon Sleeve", "Back Piece"
  description text,
  placement text,                        -- "Left forearm", "Upper back"
  style text,                            -- traditional, realism, neo-trad
  status text not null default 'active', -- active, completed, on_hold, cancelled
  total_sessions_planned int,
  total_price_cents int,
  deposit_pool_cents int not null default 0,  -- pooled deposit across sessions
  deposit_applied_cents int not null default 0,
  moodboard_url text,
  cover_photo_url text,
  started_at timestamptz,
  completed_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,
  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null
);

-- Link bookings to projects (nullable; bookings can exist without a project)
alter table bookings add column project_id uuid references projects(id) on delete set null;
alter table bookings add column session_number int;  -- "Session 2 of 5"

-- Reference images per project
create table project_references (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  project_id uuid not null references projects(id) on delete cascade,
  storage_path text not null,
  caption text,
  display_order int default 0,
  created_at timestamptz default now() not null
);

-- Photo progression per session (before/after/healing)
create table project_progress_photos (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  project_id uuid not null references projects(id) on delete cascade,
  booking_id uuid references bookings(id) on delete set null,
  storage_path text not null,
  kind text not null,  -- 'before' | 'after' | 'healed' | 'reference'
  taken_at timestamptz,
  display_order int default 0,
  created_at timestamptz default now() not null
);

-- RLS (studio_id via studio_members) + indexes on all FKs + updated_at trigger
```

**Backend** — Koda (Pod A):
- `lib/projects/queries.ts` — `listProjects`, `getProject`, `getProjectWithSessions`, `getProjectDepositLedger`
- `lib/projects/mutations.ts` — `createProject`, `updateProject`, `linkBookingToProject`, `allocateDepositToSession`, `completeProject`
- Server Actions in `app/(app)/projects/actions.ts`
- API routes (only where needed for mobile/public access): `app/api/projects/[id]/route.ts`

**Frontend** — new sidebar item between Calendar and Messages; full pages:
- `app/(app)/projects/page.tsx` — list (grid + filter by status/artist/client)
- `app/(app)/projects/new/page.tsx` — create form (pulls from existing clients)
- `app/(app)/projects/[id]/page.tsx` — detail with 5 tabs:
  - **Sessions** — linked bookings, "Session 3 of 6" badge, total completed vs planned, CTA "Book next session"
  - **Deposit** — pooled balance, applied-to-session ledger, balance due, refund flow
  - **References** — moodboard grid, drag-to-reorder, upload to Supabase Storage
  - **Progress** — before/after/healing photos per session, timeline view
  - **Details** — name, placement, style, notes, primary artist, status
- `components/projects/ProjectCard.tsx` — list card w/ cover photo, session counter, deposit status pill
- `components/projects/SessionTimeline.tsx` — vertical timeline with completed / upcoming
- `components/projects/DepositLedger.tsx` — ledger table (paid → allocated per session → balance)
- `components/projects/MoodboardGrid.tsx` — drag-sortable image grid

**Sidebar wiring (LOCKED)** — Projects lives in **top nav group between Calendar and Messages** in `components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts`:
```ts
// Top group order (after change):
// Today → Inbox → Calendar → Projects → Messages
{ id: 'projects', label: 'Projects', icon: Folders, href: '/projects',
  roles: ['owner', 'admin', 'artist', 'receptionist', 'guest_artist'] }
```
Rationale (per PDF): Projects is InkOS's biggest moat primitive — putting it adjacent to Calendar signals it's a first-class workflow object, not a buried client feature.

**Integration points:**
- Client detail page (`app/(app)/clients/[id]/page.tsx`) — new "Projects" tab grouping bookings by project
- Appointment drawer — when creating/editing a booking, optional `project_id` picker + auto session-number increment
- Calendar — multi-session bookings show mini chain icon linking to project

---

### A2. Messages (unified inbox) — 2nd biggest moat

**Competitor pattern (TattooClient):** IG DM + FB + SMS + email in one thread per client. Priced at $297/mo because their tech is a GoHighLevel rebrand. InkOS can ship native for $29-99/mo.

**Scope locked: v1 = SMS (Twilio) + Email (Resend) only.** Instagram DM / Facebook Messenger via Meta Graph API deferred to v2 (blocker: Meta app review is 2-4 weeks). Voice AI deferred to v3.

**Infrastructure already built:**
- `client_communications` table (channel, direction, status, subject, body, provider_message_id, metadata, timestamps) ✅
- `/api/client-communications` GET/POST routes ✅
- `lib/email/resend.ts` — Resend client + 7 transactional templates ✅
- `lib/sms/templates.ts` — template scaffolding ✅ (send logic TBD)

**What needs building:**

**SMS send pipeline** (Twilio) — `lib/sms/twilio.ts`:
- `sendSms({ to, body, studioId, clientId })` — records to `client_communications` with status `queued` → `sent` → `delivered`/`failed`
- Env vars: `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN`, `TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER` (add to `lib/env.ts` Zod schema)
- Queue via BullMQ (`lib/queue.ts` already has `send-email` pattern; add `send-sms` job)
- Webhook handler `app/api/webhooks/twilio/route.ts` for inbound SMS + status updates

**Inbound routing** — new migration `supabase/migrations/20260420_inbound_messages.sql`:
```sql
-- Map inbound twilio/email to conversation thread
create table conversations (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  studio_id uuid not null references studios(id),
  client_id uuid references clients(id),  -- nullable until matched
  external_identifier text not null,      -- phone or email
  channel text not null,                  -- sms, email, instagram, facebook
  last_message_at timestamptz,
  assigned_to uuid references auth.users(id),
  unread_count int default 0,
  archived_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,
  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,
  unique (studio_id, channel, external_identifier)
);

alter table client_communications add column conversation_id uuid references conversations(id);
create index on client_communications (conversation_id, sent_at desc);
```

**UI** — replace `MessagesComingSoon`:
- `app/(app)/messages/page.tsx` — 2-column layout (threads list left, active thread right)
- `app/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/page.tsx` — thread view
- `components/messages/ThreadList.tsx` — search, channel filter (SMS/Email/All), unread count, last-message preview
- `components/messages/ThreadPanel.tsx` — message bubbles, client profile card sidebar, quick actions (book appointment, send form, take deposit)
- `components/messages/Composer.tsx` — channel selector, template picker (reuses `lib/sms/templates.ts` + Resend templates), attachment upload (images only for SMS via MMS)
- `components/messages/ClientContextCard.tsx` — sidebar showing client bookings, active projects, total spent, tags

**Realtime** — first use of Supabase Realtime in the app:
- Subscribe to `client_communications` inserts filtered by `studio_id`
- New message → toast + unread badge bump + thread list re-sort
- `hooks/use-realtime-messages.ts` (client-side)

**Unified inbox pattern:** All channels converge on `conversations.id`. Outbound messages are recorded with `direction='outbound'`; inbound webhook handlers create/find conversation then insert `client_communications` row.

**Auto-match to client:** on inbound SMS, match by phone number across `clients.phone`. On inbound email, match by `clients.email`. If no match, thread is unassigned until staff links it.

---

### A3. Auto-cancel cron for unpaid deposits

**Competitor pattern (TattooPro.io, TattooGenda):** "System holds the slot temporarily. If they don't pay within your set window (e.g., 24 hours), auto-cancel."

**Current state:** `bookings.deposit_paid` boolean + `bookings.scheduled_at` exist, but no scheduler.

**Build:**
- New setting `studio_settings.deposit_deadline_hours` (default 24)
- `workers/cron/auto-cancel-deposits.ts` — runs every 10 min via node-cron:
  ```ts
  // Find bookings where status='pending' AND deposit_paid=false AND created_at < now() - deadline
  // Set status='cancelled', cancelled_at=now(), append to status_history
  // Enqueue BullMQ job: send-email (cancellation notice) + send-sms (optional)
  // Free the slot
  ```
- Reminder job (12hr + 4hr before deadline) — reuses existing Resend templates + new SMS template
- Admin override: "Extend deadline" button on booking detail
- Studio setting UI in `app/(app)/settings/studio/page.tsx` — "Hold slots for [24] hours awaiting deposit"

---

## PHASE B — UX Polish on Shipped Functions

### B1. Calendar enhancements

**Pattern (TattooGenda):** red dot = no deposit, green dot = paid, guest-artist horizontal bars.

**Changes to `components/calendar/CalendarView.tsx`:**
- Inject deposit status dot into `eventContent` renderer — red 6px dot for `!deposit_paid && deposit_cents > 0`, green for paid, no dot if deposit not required
- Add project chain icon (link glyph) when `booking.project_id` is not null — click navigates to project detail
- Guest artist residency bars — new top strip above day/week grid:
  - Fetch from `guest_artist_engagements` where `start_date ≤ viewRange AND end_date ≥ viewRange`
  - Render as colored horizontal bars spanning engagement dates
  - Hover → popover with artist name, portfolio link, dates
- **View switcher** (role-aware): Owner sees "All chairs"; Artist sees "My chair"; Reception sees "All chairs + check-in focused"
- Add persistent view preference in `localStorage` (already partial in `filterArtistIds` URL params)

**CSS** — extend `app/globals.css`:
```css
.fc-event .deposit-dot { /* 6px circle, absolute positioned top-right */ }
.fc-event .deposit-dot.paid { background: var(--color-success); }
.fc-event .deposit-dot.unpaid { background: var(--color-destructive); }
.fc-event .project-icon { /* link glyph, absolute bottom-right */ }
.guest-artist-bar { /* inline-block, 4px tall, gradient bg */ }
```

---

### B2. Today "Queue" widgets + role-aware variants

**Pattern (TSP Queue + GlossGenius polish):** Queue surfaces check-ins pending, forms incomplete, payments due, all at-a-glance.

**Changes to `app/(app)/today/page.tsx` + `TodayClient.tsx`:**
- **New widget: `TodayQueue`** — a horizontal scroll strip showing every booking scheduled today with status chips:
  - Client avatar, time, service
  - 4 status pills: Check-in (done/pending), Forms (signed/unsigned), Deposit (paid/unpaid), Balance (paid/due)
  - Click-to-resolve: tap chip opens action drawer
- **Role-aware layout** — `getRoleFromMembership(studioMember)` determines top widget:
  - `owner`/`admin` → full Queue + KPI cards + revenue sparkline
  - `artist` → "My chair today" (filtered queue) + my earnings today
  - `receptionist` → Queue with check-in focus + inventory alerts
  - `guest_artist` → My sessions only + guest-artist perms summary
- **Quick Actions row** — "Take deposit", "Walk-in booking", "Send aftercare", "Record sale" (reuses existing POS + booking drawers)

**New components:**
- `components/today/TodayQueue.tsx` — horizontal scroll queue with status chips
- `components/today/RoleAwareHero.tsx` — switches widget set by role
- `components/today/StatusChip.tsx` — 4-state pill (red/amber/blue/green)

---

### B3. Inbox urgency grouping + smart triage

**Pattern (Linear):** urgency-bucketed groups (Now, Today, This Week, Later) + batch resolve.

**Changes to `app/(app)/inbox/page.tsx`:**
- **New urgency buckets**: computed per item:
  - `now` — deposits overdue, forms unsigned for appointments <24h away, reschedule requests <2h old
  - `today` — pending bookings in next 48h, waitlist signups <24h
  - `this_week` — new clients, consent forms >24h unsigned
  - `later` — general activity
- **Batch actions:** checkbox per item + "Resolve all" / "Assign to..." top bar
- **Item-level one-click CTAs:**
  - Deposit overdue → "Send reminder SMS" (reuses Phase A2)
  - Form unsigned → "Resend form link"
  - New client → "Send welcome"
  - Waitlist → "Offer slot" (opens booking drawer pre-filled)
- **Assign to team member** — new `inbox_assignments` table (id, studio_id, inbox_item_key, assigned_to, snoozed_until)
- **Keyboard shortcuts** — `j`/`k` navigate, `e` archive, `a` assign, `r` resolve (pattern from Linear)

**New components:**
- `components/inbox/UrgencyGroup.tsx` — collapsible group header
- `components/inbox/InboxItemCTA.tsx` — per-type one-click action button
- `components/inbox/BatchActionBar.tsx` — multi-select bar

---

## PHASE C — Appointment flow polish

### C1. Booking-link hub + QR code

**Pattern (GlossGenius, Venue Ink):** "Copy and paste your booking link anywhere — Instagram bio, stories, DMs, website."

**Build:**
- New page `app/(app)/settings/booking-page/page.tsx` (may already exist as "Booking Page config" — verify):
  - Public URL display with copy button: `inkos.app/book/{studioSlug}`
  - Per-artist booking links: `inkos.app/book/{studioSlug}/artist/{artistSlug}`
  - QR code generator (use `qrcode` npm package) — download PNG/SVG
  - Preview embed with mobile frame
  - Social share presets: Instagram bio link format, Linktree-style hub page

### C2. Flash day event booking

**Pattern (Venue Ink):** one-off events with pre-set time slots, bookable at a flat rate.

**Data model:**
```sql
create table flash_events (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  studio_id uuid not null references studios(id),
  artist_id uuid references artists(id),
  title text not null,            -- "Halloween Flash Day"
  description text,
  event_date date not null,
  slot_duration_min int not null,
  slot_price_cents int not null,
  deposit_cents int,
  cover_image_url text,
  max_slots int,
  flyer_url text,
  public boolean default true,
  created_at timestamptz default now() not null
);

-- flash_event_slots generated from event (time-block → booking links)
```

**UI:**
- `app/(app)/flash-events/page.tsx` — list
- `app/(app)/flash-events/new/page.tsx` — create (pick artist, date, slot length, flash sheet upload)
- `app/book/[studioSlug]/flash/[eventId]/page.tsx` — public slot picker

---

## Critical files to modify / create

### Modify
- `components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts` — add `Projects` nav item between Calendar and Messages (role-aware for all tattoo roles)
- `components/calendar/CalendarView.tsx` — inject deposit dots, project icons, guest bars
- `app/(app)/today/page.tsx` + `TodayClient.tsx` — wire TodayQueue + role-aware hero
- `app/(app)/inbox/page.tsx` — urgency buckets + batch actions + CTAs
- `app/(app)/messages/page.tsx` — replace `MessagesComingSoon` with full thread UI
- `app/globals.css` — deposit-dot, project-icon, guest-artist-bar CSS
- `lib/env.ts` — add Twilio + deposit deadline env vars
- `lib/queue.ts` — add `send-sms` job type
- `app/(app)/clients/[id]/page.tsx` — new "Projects" tab
- `components/appointments/AppointmentDrawer.tsx` — project_id picker
- `app/(app)/settings/studio/page.tsx` — deposit deadline setting

### Create
- `supabase/migrations/20260420_projects.sql` — projects + project_references + project_progress_photos + booking.project_id FK

**Outcome:** Close the 3 confirmed gaps (Projects greenfield, Messages stub, auto-cancel cron), layer premium UX enhancements on the 3 already-shipped functions (Today, Inbox, Calendar), and end with a product that beats TattooGenda on projects, matches TattooClient on unified messaging, and outshines GlossGenius on polish.

# InkOS — Competitor-Informed Implementation Plan (6 Core Functions)

## Context

User provided a 32-page competitor research PDF covering 9 rivals (DaySmart, Tattoo Studio Pro, TattooGenda, TattooPro.io, TattooClient, Venue Ink, Zylu, InkDesk, GlossGenius) across 6 sidebar functions: **Today, Inbox, Calendar, Messages, Appointment, Projects**. Goal: deep-dive check against current InkOS state, then implement each function pixel-perfect with competitor-informed patterns baked in.

**Outcome:** Close the 3 confirmed gaps (Projects greenfield, Messages stub, auto-cancel cron), layer premium UX enhancements on the 3 already-shipped functions (Today, Inbox, Calendar), and end with a product that beats TattooGenda on projects, matches TattooClient on unified messaging, and outshines GlossGenius on polish.

---

## Current-State Audit (from 3 parallel Explore agents)

| Function | Route | Status | Gap vs. competitors |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Today** | `app/(app)/today/page.tsx` | ✅ Full — KPIs, agenda, activity feed, inventory alerts | Missing TSP-style "Queue" check-in row + role-aware owner/artist/reception variants |
| **Inbox** | `app/(app)/inbox/page.tsx` | ✅ Full — 4 signals (deposits, forms, clients, waitlist) | Missing Linear-grade urgency grouping + one-click resolve actions |
| **Calendar** | `app/(app)/calendar/page.tsx` | ✅ Full — FullCalendar, multi-artist, drag-reschedule, filters | Missing **visible red/green deposit dots** + guest-artist horizontal bars |
| **Messages** | `app/(app)/messages/page.tsx` | ⚠️ **STUB** — `MessagesComingSoon` component only | `client_communications` table + Resend wired; needs full thread UI + SMS send + Realtime |
| **Appointment** | `app/(app)/appointments/*` + `/book/[studioSlug]` | ✅ Full — Dodo deposits, intake forms, public flow | Missing **auto-cancel cron** for unpaid deposits + booking-link hub + QR code |
| **Projects** | **No route, no table** | ❌ **GREENFIELD** | Biggest moat — TattooGenda is the only competitor with projects, and their UI is 2015-era |

---

## Build Priority (Moat × Gap)

1. **Projects** — greenfield, biggest moat (TattooGenda's only native feature, poorly executed)
2. **Messages** — infrastructure is 50% done (`client_communications` table + Resend + SMS templates exist); ship the UI + send logic
3. **Auto-cancel cron** — critical missing piece on Appointment flow (TattooPro.io ships this)
4. **Calendar deposit dots + guest bars** — visual polish to match TattooGenda's tattoo-native UX
5. **Today "Queue" widget + role-aware variants** — copy TSP's pattern, apply GlossGenius polish
6. **Inbox urgency grouping + AI triage** — Linear-grade triage that no tattoo competitor has

---

## PHASE A — Critical Gaps (greenfield / stubbed)

### A1. Projects (multi-session tattoos) — biggest moat

**Competitor pattern (TattooGenda):** one Project = N Sessions, shared deposit pool, linked appointments, stored references, session remaining counter. Their UI is dated; InkOS can leapfrog.

**Data model** — new migration `supabase/migrations/20260420_projects.sql`:
```sql
create table projects (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  studio_id uuid not null references studios(id) on delete cascade,
  client_id uuid not null references clients(id) on delete cascade,
  primary_artist_id uuid references artists(id) on delete set null,
  name text not null,                    -- "Dragon Sleeve", "Back Piece"
  description text,
  placement text,                        -- "Left forearm", "Upper back"
  style text,                            -- traditional, realism, neo-trad
  status text not null default 'active', -- active, completed, on_hold, cancelled
  total_sessions_planned int,
  total_price_cents int,
  deposit_pool_cents int not null default 0,  -- pooled deposit across sessions
  deposit_applied_cents int not null default 0,
  moodboard_url text,
  cover_photo_url text,
  started_at timestamptz,
  completed_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,
  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null
);

-- Link bookings to projects (nullable; bookings can exist without a project)
alter table bookings add column project_id uuid references projects(id) on delete set null;
alter table bookings add column session_number int;  -- "Session 2 of 5"

-- Reference images per project
create table project_references (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  project_id uuid not null references projects(id) on delete cascade,
  storage_path text not null,
  caption text,
  display_order int default 0,
  created_at timestamptz default now() not null
);

-- Photo progression per session (before/after/healing)
create table project_progress_photos (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  project_id uuid not null references projects(id) on delete cascade,
  booking_id uuid references bookings(id) on delete set null,
  storage_path text not null,
  kind text not null,  -- 'before' | 'after' | 'healed' | 'reference'
  taken_at timestamptz,
  display_order int default 0,
  created_at timestamptz default now() not null
);

-- RLS (studio_id via studio_members) + indexes on all FKs + updated_at trigger
```

**Backend** — Koda (Pod A):
- `lib/projects/queries.ts` — `listProjects`, `getProject`, `getProjectWithSessions`, `getProjectDepositLedger`
- `lib/projects/mutations.ts` — `createProject`, `updateProject`, `linkBookingToProject`, `allocateDepositToSession`, `completeProject`
- Server Actions in `app/(app)/projects/actions.ts`
- API routes (only where needed for mobile/public access): `app/api/projects/[id]/route.ts`

**Frontend** — new sidebar item between Calendar and Messages; full pages:
- `app/(app)/projects/page.tsx` — list (grid + filter by status/artist/client)
- `app/(app)/projects/new/page.tsx` — create form (pulls from existing clients)
- `app/(app)/projects/[id]/page.tsx` — detail with 5 tabs:
  - **Sessions** — linked bookings, "Session 3 of 6" badge, total completed vs planned, CTA "Book next session"
  - **Deposit** — pooled balance, applied-to-session ledger, balance due, refund flow
  - **References** — moodboard grid, drag-to-reorder, upload to Supabase Storage
  - **Progress** — before/after/healing photos per session, timeline view
  - **Details** — name, placement, style, notes, primary artist, status
- `components/projects/ProjectCard.tsx` — list card w/ cover photo, session counter, deposit status pill
- `components/projects/SessionTimeline.tsx` — vertical timeline with completed / upcoming
- `components/projects/DepositLedger.tsx` — ledger table (paid → allocated per session → balance)
- `components/projects/MoodboardGrid.tsx` — drag-sortable image grid

**Sidebar wiring (LOCKED)** — Projects lives in **top nav group between Calendar and Messages** in `components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts`:
```ts
// Top group order (after change):
// Today → Inbox → Calendar → Projects → Messages
{ id: 'projects', label: 'Projects', icon: Folders, href: '/projects',
  roles: ['owner', 'admin', 'artist', 'receptionist', 'guest_artist'] }
```
Rationale (per PDF): Projects is InkOS's biggest moat primitive — putting it adjacent to Calendar signals it's a first-class workflow object, not a buried client feature.

**Integration points:**
- Client detail page (`app/(app)/clients/[id]/page.tsx`) — new "Projects" tab grouping bookings by project
- Appointment drawer — when creating/editing a booking, optional `project_id` picker + auto session-number increment
- Calendar — multi-session bookings show mini chain icon linking to project

---

### A2. Messages (unified inbox) — 2nd biggest moat

**Competitor pattern (TattooClient):** IG DM + FB + SMS + email in one thread per client. Priced at $297/mo because their tech is a GoHighLevel rebrand. InkOS can ship native for $29-99/mo.

**Scope locked: v1 = SMS (Twilio) + Email (Resend) only.** Instagram DM / Facebook Messenger via Meta Graph API deferred to v2 (blocker: Meta app review is 2-4 weeks). Voice AI deferred to v3.

**Infrastructure already built:**
- `client_communications` table (channel, direction, status, subject, body, provider_message_id, metadata, timestamps) ✅
- `/api/client-communications` GET/POST routes ✅
- `lib/email/resend.ts` — Resend client + 7 transactional templates ✅
- `lib/sms/templates.ts` — template scaffolding ✅ (send logic TBD)

**What needs building:**

**SMS send pipeline** (Twilio) — `lib/sms/twilio.ts`:
- `sendSms({ to, body, studioId, clientId })` — records to `client_communications` with status `queued` → `sent` → `delivered`/`failed`
- Env vars: `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN`, `TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER` (add to `lib/env.ts` Zod schema)
- Queue via BullMQ (`lib/queue.ts` already has `send-email` pattern; add `send-sms` job)
- Webhook handler `app/api/webhooks/twilio/route.ts` for inbound SMS + status updates

**Inbound routing** — new migration `supabase/migrations/20260420_inbound_messages.sql`:
```sql
-- Map inbound twilio/email to conversation thread
create table conversations (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  studio_id uuid not null references studios(id),
  client_id uuid references clients(id),  -- nullable until matched
  external_identifier text not null,      -- phone or email
  channel text not null,                  -- sms, email, instagram, facebook
  last_message_at timestamptz,
  assigned_to uuid references auth.users(id),
  unread_count int default 0,
  archived_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,
  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,
  unique (studio_id, channel, external_identifier)
);

alter table client_communications add column conversation_id uuid references conversations(id);
create index on client_communications (conversation_id, sent_at desc);
```

**UI** — replace `MessagesComingSoon`:
- `app/(app)/messages/page.tsx` — 2-column layout (threads list left, active thread right)
- `app/(app)/messages/[conversationId]/page.tsx` — thread view
- `components/messages/ThreadList.tsx` — search, channel filter (SMS/Email/All), unread count, last-message preview
- `components/messages/ThreadPanel.tsx` — message bubbles, client profile card sidebar, quick actions (book appointment, send form, take deposit)
- `components/messages/Composer.tsx` — channel selector, template picker (reuses `lib/sms/templates.ts` + Resend templates), attachment upload (images only for SMS via MMS)
- `components/messages/ClientContextCard.tsx` — sidebar showing client bookings, active projects, total spent, tags

**Realtime** — first use of Supabase Realtime in the app:
- Subscribe to `client_communications` inserts filtered by `studio_id`
- New message → toast + unread badge bump + thread list re-sort
- `hooks/use-realtime-messages.ts` (client-side)

**Unified inbox pattern:** All channels converge on `conversations.id`. Outbound messages are recorded with `direction='outbound'`; inbound webhook handlers create/find conversation then insert `client_communications` row.

**Auto-match to client:** on inbound SMS, match by phone number across `clients.phone`. On inbound email, match by `clients.email`. If no match, thread is unassigned until staff links it.

---

### A3. Auto-cancel cron for unpaid deposits

**Competitor pattern (TattooPro.io, TattooGenda):** "System holds the slot temporarily. If they don't pay within your set window (e.g., 24 hours), auto-cancel."

**Current state:** `bookings.deposit_paid` boolean + `bookings.scheduled_at` exist, but no scheduler.

**Build:**
- New setting `studio_settings.deposit_deadline_hours` (default 24)
- `workers/cron/auto-cancel-deposits.ts` — runs every 10 min via node-cron:
  ```ts
  // Find bookings where status='pending' AND deposit_paid=false AND created_at < now() - deadline
  // Set status='cancelled', cancelled_at=now(), append to status_history
  // Enqueue BullMQ job: send-email (cancellation notice) + send-sms (optional)
  // Free the slot
  ```
- Reminder job (12hr + 4hr before deadline) — reuses existing Resend templates + new SMS template
- Admin override: "Extend deadline" button on booking detail
- Studio setting UI in `app/(app)/settings/studio/page.tsx` — "Hold slots for [24] hours awaiting deposit"

---

## PHASE B — UX Polish on Shipped Functions

### B1. Calendar enhancements

**Pattern (TattooGenda):** red dot = no deposit, green dot = paid, guest-artist horizontal bars.

**Changes to `components/calendar/CalendarView.tsx`:**
- Inject deposit status dot into `eventContent` renderer — red 6px dot for `!deposit_paid && deposit_cents > 0`, green for paid, no dot if deposit not required
- Add project chain icon (link glyph) when `booking.project_id` is not null — click navigates to project detail
- Guest artist residency bars — new top strip above day/week grid:
  - Fetch from `guest_artist_engagements` where `start_date ≤ viewRange AND end_date ≥ viewRange`
  - Render as colored horizontal bars spanning engagement dates
  - Hover → popover with artist name, portfolio link, dates
- **View switcher** (role-aware): Owner sees "All chairs"; Artist sees "My chair"; Reception sees "All chairs + check-in focused"
- Add persistent view preference in `localStorage` (already partial in `filterArtistIds` URL params)

**CSS** — extend `app/globals.css`:
```css
.fc-event .deposit-dot { /* 6px circle, absolute positioned top-right */ }
.fc-event .deposit-dot.paid { background: var(--color-success); }
.fc-event .deposit-dot.unpaid { background: var(--color-destructive); }
.fc-event .project-icon { /* link glyph, absolute bottom-right */ }
.guest-artist-bar { /* inline-block, 4px tall, gradient bg */ }
```

### B2. Today "Queue" widgets + role-aware variants

**Pattern (TSP Queue + GlossGenius polish):** Queue surfaces check-ins pending, forms incomplete, payments due, all at-a-glance.

**Changes to `app/(app)/today/page.tsx` + `TodayClient.tsx`:**
- **New widget: `TodayQueue`** — a horizontal scroll strip showing every booking scheduled today with status chips:
  - Client avatar, time, service
  - 4 status pills: Check-in (done/pending), Forms (signed/unsigned), Deposit (paid/unpaid), Balance (paid/due)
  - Click-to-resolve: tap chip opens action drawer
- **Role-aware layout** — `getRoleFromMembership(studioMember)` determines top widget:
  - `owner`/`admin` → full Queue + KPI cards + revenue sparkline
  - `artist` → "My chair today" (filtered queue) + my earnings today
  - `receptionist` → Queue with check-in focus + inventory alerts
  - `guest_artist` → My sessions only + guest-artist perms summary
- **Quick Actions row** — "Take deposit", "Walk-in booking", "Send aftercare", "Record sale" (reuses existing POS + booking drawers)

**New components:**
- `components/today/TodayQueue.tsx` — horizontal scroll queue with status chips
- `components/today/RoleAwareHero.tsx` — switches widget set by role
- `components/today/StatusChip.tsx` — 4-state pill (red/amber/blue/green)

---

### B3. Inbox urgency grouping + smart triage

**Pattern (Linear):** urgency-bucketed groups (Now, Today, This Week, Later) + batch resolve.

**Changes to `app/(app)/inbox/page.tsx`:**
- **New urgency buckets**: computed per item:
  - `now` — deposits overdue, forms unsigned for appointments <24h away, reschedule requests <2h old
  - `today` — pending bookings in next 48h, waitlist signups <24h
  - `this_week` — new clients, consent forms >24h unsigned
  - `later` — general activity
- **Batch actions:** checkbox per item + "Resolve all" / "Assign to..." top bar
- **Item-level one-click CTAs:**
  - Deposit overdue → "Send reminder SMS" (reuses Phase A2)
  - Form unsigned → "Resend form link"
  - New client → "Send welcome"
  - Waitlist → "Offer slot" (opens booking drawer pre-filled)
- **Assign to team member** — new `inbox_assignments` table (id, studio_id, inbox_item_key, assigned_to, snoozed_until)
- **Keyboard shortcuts** — `j`/`k` navigate, `e` archive, `a` assign, `r` resolve (pattern from Linear)

**New components:**
- `components/inbox/UrgencyGroup.tsx` — collapsible group header
- `components/inbox/InboxItemCTA.tsx` — per-type one-click action button
- `components/inbox/BatchActionBar.tsx` — multi-select bar

## PHASE C — Appointment flow polish

### C1. Booking-link hub + QR code

**Pattern (GlossGenius, Venue Ink):** "Copy and paste your booking link anywhere — Instagram bio, stories, DMs, website."

**Build:**

**Data model:**

create table flash_events (

  title text not null,            -- "Halloween Flash Day"

);

fix(s18): prod catch-up SQL + gating cleanup + sidebar dropdown + portfolio polish

Closes the production bugs Yash hit after PRs #4 + #5 merged. Four
disjoint sprints addressed in one shipment since none depend on each
other (except Sprint 1 which the ops team runs out-of-band).

Sprint 1 — Prod DB catch-up
  scripts/s18-prod-catchup.sql
    Bundles all 9 S18 migrations (projects, conversations, inbox
    assignments, flash events, deposit deadline + reminders, twilio
    phone, artists.slug) into one idempotent file. Open Supabase SQL
    editor on the prod project, paste, run, verify with the sanity
    queries at the bottom, then create 3 storage buckets manually
    (project-references, project-photos, flash-event-assets). This
    fixes the "Something went wrong" SSR crashes on /projects,
    /clients, /artists, /payments and the "Couldn't load
    appointments" banner on /calendar.

Sprint 2 — Remove plan-gating redirects (keep badges visual)
  components/app/sidebar/SidebarNavGroup.tsx
    Removed the `isGated ? router.push('/settings/billing')`
    redirect and the `<button>` vs `<Link>` render switch. Every
    sidebar item now always navigates to its own href. The STUDIO /
    PRO plan pill still renders (now via the dedicated
    `showPlanBadge` flag) as a visual hint. Removed the opacity-60
    dim that made gated items feel disabled.
  app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx
  app/(app)/marketing/page.tsx
    Removed `UpgradeGatePageBlock` server-side blocks. Pages now
    render for all plans. S19 will reintroduce contextual upsell
    inside features (e.g., per-campaign send-cap warnings) instead
    of blanket page redirects.

  components/app/sidebar/SidebarUserFooter.tsx
    Full rewrite replacing the static gear-icon link with a
    DropdownMenu mirroring the AppHeader top-right pattern:

      • Account:    My profile, Account settings

      • Appearance: Light / Dark / System submenu
      • Sign out:   destructive, calls supabase.auth.signOut +

## Summary

Closes the production bugs that landed in PRs #4 + #5. Four disjoint fixes in one shipment.

### Sprint 1 — Prod DB catch-up (most critical)

**`scripts/s18-prod-catchup.sql`** — run this against prod Supabase before/after merging to fix the SSR crashes on `/projects`, `/clients`, `/artists`, `/payments` and the "Couldn't load appointments" banner on `/calendar`.

How to run:
1. Open Supabase dashboard → SQL editor (prod project)
2. Paste the file, click Run (safe to re-run — all idempotent)
3. Verify with the sanity queries at the bottom (expects 8 new tables, 5 new booking columns, 2 new studio columns, etc.)
4. Storage tab → create 3 private buckets: `project-references`, `project-photos`, `flash-event-assets`

### Sprint 2 — Remove plan-gating redirects

- `SidebarNavGroup.tsx` — clicking Inventory/Analytics/AI/Marketing/Flash Events now navigates to the actual page instead of bouncing to `/settings/billing`. The STUDIO / PRO pill still renders as a visual hint. Per product direction: badge stays, gate goes.
- `inventory/page.tsx` + `marketing/page.tsx` — removed `UpgradeGatePageBlock` server-side redirects. Pages now render for all plans. S19 will reintroduce contextual in-feature upsell instead of page-level blocks.

### Sprint 3 — Sidebar profile dropdown

- `SidebarUserFooter.tsx` — full rewrite. The static gear-icon link becomes a full `DropdownMenu` mirroring the AppHeader top-right pattern:
  - **Profile header** — avatar + name + email + role chip
  - **Account** — My profile, Account settings
  - **Workspace** (owner/admin only) — Studio settings, Team & members, Billing & plan, Integrations
  - **Appearance** — Light / Dark / System submenu
  - **Sign out** — destructive, calls `supabase.auth.signOut` + redirect

# InkOS — Base UI error #31 hotfix

## Context

Production is broken on every authenticated page after commit `200eb35` (the sidebar bug-fix sprint merged as PR #6 into `main`). The browser throws:

```
Error: Base UI error #31
    at i_ (.../0qosc3o6d2baw.js:24:110648)
    at oq (...145743)
    at su (...185747)
```

The error fires during React render/hydration on every authenticated route.

## Root cause

Base UI error code 31 comes from `node_modules/@base-ui/react/menu/group/MenuGroupContext.js` line 17:

```js
throw new Error('Base UI: MenuGroupRootContext is missing. Menu group parts must be used within <Menu.Group>.');
```

The error fires when `MenuPrimitive.GroupLabel` mounts without a surrounding `MenuPrimitive.Group`. Our `components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx` maps `DropdownMenuLabel` onto `MenuPrimitive.GroupLabel`, so any `<DropdownMenuLabel>` used without an enclosing `<DropdownMenuGroup>` throws.

### Why it's only showing up now

The `DropdownMenuLabel` pattern without a surrounding Group has existed for a while in AppHeader, StudioSwitcher, LocationSwitcher (all latent error #31 triggers). But the newly-shipped dropdowns push one of them onto the render path of every page load — the SidebarUserFooter dropdown from commit `200eb35` is rendered on every authenticated route, and Base UI's dropdown primitives appear to be instantiating context during mount, tripping the error even before the dropdown is clicked.

## Affected files (5 call sites of `DropdownMenuLabel`)

Every file uses `DropdownMenuLabel` directly under `DropdownMenuContent`, with no `DropdownMenuGroup` wrapper:

| File | Line | Current usage |
|---|---|---|
| `components/app/sidebar/SidebarUserFooter.tsx` | ~125 | Profile header (avatar + name + email + role) |
| `components/app/sidebar/AppHeader.tsx` | ~358 | Top-right user menu header |
| `components/shared/StudioSwitcher.tsx` | ~130 | "Switch studio" heading |
| `components/shared/LocationSwitcher.tsx` | ~88 | "Switch location" heading |
| `components/messages/Composer.tsx` | ~234 | "Quick templates" heading |

None of the 5 uses `DropdownMenuGroup` around the label.

## Recommended fix — one-line wrapper change

Modify the primitive wrapper `components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx` so that `DropdownMenuLabel` internally wraps its child `MenuPrimitive.GroupLabel` inside a `MenuPrimitive.Group`. This fixes ALL 5 call sites without touching any of them.

### Exact diff

**File:** `components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx` (lines ~56–74)

```ts
// BEFORE
function DropdownMenuLabel({
  className,
  inset,
  ...props
}: MenuPrimitive.GroupLabel.Props & { inset?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <MenuPrimitive.GroupLabel
      data-slot="dropdown-menu-label"
      data-inset={inset}
      className={cn(
        "px-1.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground data-inset:pl-7",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

// AFTER
function DropdownMenuLabel({
  className,
  inset,
  ...props
}: MenuPrimitive.GroupLabel.Props & { inset?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <MenuPrimitive.Group>
      <MenuPrimitive.GroupLabel
        data-slot="dropdown-menu-label"
        data-inset={inset}
        className={cn(
          "px-1.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground data-inset:pl-7",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    </MenuPrimitive.Group>
  )
}
```

### Why this over the alternative

Alternative would be to wrap `<DropdownMenuLabel>` in `<DropdownMenuGroup>` in each of the 5 caller files. The alternative is more ARIA-correct (a group should contain the label plus its related items), but:

- 5× blast radius vs. 1-file change
- The 5 current uses treat the label as a visual heading, not a semantic group label — none of them actually have related sub-items that a screen-reader group would benefit from
- The wrapper fix keeps future usages safe without every new caller having to remember the rule
- Visual layout unaffected: `MenuPrimitive.Group` renders a bare `<div role="group">` with no padding/margin

ARIA cost is minor: each label sits inside a group with no siblings, which is equivalent to an empty landmark. Not a regression vs. the current behavior (which is just a loose label inside the menu popup).

## Verification

Before committing:

1. **Typecheck clean** — `pnpm typecheck`
2. **Build clean** — `pnpm build`
3. **Local dev smoke** — `pnpm dev`, open any authenticated page (`/today`, `/clients`, `/projects`), confirm:
   - No "Base UI error #31" in browser console
   - No error boundary rendered
   - Sidebar profile dropdown opens on click and shows header + items
   - AppHeader top-right user menu opens and shows header + items
   - Studio switcher in AppHeader opens (if multi-studio available)
   - Messages composer template picker opens and shows "Quick templates" heading

After deploying to main:

- Navigate to `https://inkos.up.railway.app/today` in an incognito window
- No error on page load
- Click the bottom-of-sidebar profile — dropdown opens cleanly
- Click through every menu item

## Critical files

- **Modify:** `components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx` (one function, ~6 lines added)

That's it. No other file changes needed.

## Out of scope (not touching this sprint)

- Refactoring the 5 caller files to use proper `DropdownMenuGroup` semantics — can ship that as a polish PR later if ARIA audit needs it
- The earlier Explore agent's theory that "render + children" on `DropdownMenuTrigger` is the cause — confirmed FALSE after reading base-ui source (error #31 is specifically the GroupLabel/Group context error, not composition). That pattern is correct.

  inset,

## Recommended Breadcrumb Architecture

**Approach: Hybrid Option B + Static Map**

This is a pragmatic middle ground that balances simplicity, performance, and UX:

- **Core**: Static `lib/breadcrumbs.ts` with pathname parsing + segment-to-label map
- **Dynamic entity names**: Optional context provider for detail pages to override generic labels
- **Performance**: No extra DB calls; detail pages can opt-in to fetch and register their entity name

### Architecture Detail

**Primary: `lib/breadcrumbs.ts` (Static Map + Parser)**

```typescript
getBreadcrumbs(pathname, searchParams) → [{label, href}]
```

Returns breadcrumb trail. Always starts with "Dashboard". Parser handles:
- Tab-based pages (e.g., `/payments?tab=commissions` → "Dashboard > Payments > Commissions")
- Dynamic segments (show generic "Details" or entity name if registered)
- Nested paths (e.g., `/clients/abc/projects` → "Dashboard > Clients > [Client] > Projects")

**Secondary: Optional `<BreadcrumbContext>` (Client Component)**

Wrapped in `app/(app)/layout.tsx`. Pages can call:
```typescript
useBreadcrumb({label: 'Acme Corp', href: undefined}) // Override [id] segment

**Current problem**: StudioSwitcher occupies the first breadcrumb, breaking nav hierarchy.

  Right: [StudioSwitcher pill] [Search] [Theme] [User menu]

**Rationale**:

- Frees breadcrumb for actual nav hierarchy
- Easier to scope breadcrumbs to single studio

1. **Create `lib/breadcrumbs.ts`** — static map + `getBreadcrumbs(pathname, searchParams)` function

- **StudioSwitcher** moves right → breadcrumb becomes pure navigation hierarchy

- Implementation is incremental: start with static, add context later if needed

**Current problem**: StudioSwitcher occupies the first breadcrumb, breaking nav hierarchy.

**Solution**: Move to **right side of AppHeader**, as a **distinct pill/dropdown** (like dark mode toggle, not part of breadcrumb):

```
[AppHeader]
  Left:  [SidebarTrigger] | [Breadcrumb: Dashboard > Inbox > ...]
  Right: [StudioSwitcher pill] [Search] [Theme] [User menu]
```

**Rationale**:
- StudioSwitcher is *identity/context*, not *navigation*
- Matches Slack/Linear UX (workspace switcher is top-right, not breadcrumb)
- Frees breadcrumb for actual nav hierarchy
- Easier to scope breadcrumbs to single studio

Rename scope - 26 `/today` references across 23 files + auth callbacks + command palette + G-chord map - Legacy `app/(app)/dashboard/` exists and is a duplicate of /today (renders identical KPI row + GettingStarted + TodayAgenda + QuickActions) — safe to delete - `next.config.ts` currently has `source: '/dashboard' → destination: '/today'` — needs to flip ### 2. Breadcrumb design failure - `components/app/sidebar/AppHeader.tsx` lines 250–302 hardcode `[StudioName|StudioSwitcher] > [LocationSwitcher?] > [PageLabel]` - No handling of tab state, detail entity names, or multi-level hierarchy - StudioSwitcher occupies the first crumb — it's workspace identity, not navigation ### 3. Default: 1440px. {children}
} return (
{children}
) } ``` **Why this shape:** matches the existing TodayClient pattern (the gold standard), responsive by default, and `fullHeight` escape hatch keeps Calendar + Messages working. --- ### Sprint 1 — Today → Dashboard rename (URL + label + backlinks) **Deletes** (stale legacy dashboard — confirmed duplicate of /today): - `app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx` - `app/(app)/dashboard/DashboardClient.tsx` - `app/(app)/dashboard/loading.tsx` **Moves:** - `app/(app)/today/page.tsx` → `app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx` (git mv) **Backlink edits** (23 files, `/today` → `/dashboard`): - `app/(auth)/callback/route.ts` (2 refs), `app/(auth)/onboarding/page.tsx` - `app/page.tsx` (root redirect) - `components/auth/LoginForm.tsx` (2 refs), `components/auth/ResetPasswordForm.tsx` - `components/invite/InviteAcceptCard.tsx` - `app/(app)/settings/studio/{policies,profile,ink-registry}/page.tsx` — auth redirect fallback - `app/(app)/dev/design/page.tsx` - `app/admin/{studios,system,ai-usage,billing}/page.tsx` — non-admin bounce - `app/(app)/not-found.tsx` (2 refs) - `components/shared/{CommandPalette,BottomNav,PageError,MobileNav}.tsx` - `components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts` — label "Today" → "Dashboard", href `/today` → `/dashboard`, icon stays `SunMedium` (or swap to `LayoutDashboard`) - `components/app/sidebar/AppHeader.tsx` — PAGE_LABELS map, G-chord `d` target, BreadcrumbLink href, pathname equality checks (5 refs) - `components/app/sidebar/SidebarNavGroup.tsx` — exact-match special case (line 54) **Redirect:** flip `next.config.ts`: ```ts // BEFORE: { source: '/dashboard', destination: '/today', permanent: true } // AFTER: { source: '/today', destination: '/dashboard', permanent: true } ``` **Middleware:** no change needed — `lib/supabase/middleware.ts:50` already checks `/dashboard` as protected. **API routes:** `app/api/today/queue/*` and `lib/today/*` stay named "today" (internal only; SEGMENT_LABELS[seg] ?? seg crumbs.push({ label, href: isLast ? undefined : built }) }) // If this URL is a tab host and tab is set, append the tab crumb const tabHost = TAB_HOSTS[pathname] if (tabHost && tab && tabHost.keyMap[tab]) { crumbs.push({ label: tabHost.keyMap[tab] }) } return crumbs } ``` **Breadcrumb render site:** `components/app/sidebar/AppHeader.tsx` — replace lines 250–302 with a `` component that calls `getBreadcrumbs(pathname, searchParams.get('tab'), {})`. **Dynamic entity names (v1 deferred):** Ship with generic labels ("Client", "Project", etc. falling back to the segment). V2 adds a BreadcrumbContext provider + `useBreadcrumb()` hook so detail pages can register their real entity name. For this sprint: static + tab-aware is enough — user feedback loop can flag which detail pages need names resolved. **StudioSwitcher relocation:** move from first breadcrumb to the right side of AppHeader, beside the search button. On mobile, it collapses into the user menu. Keeps workspace identity visible but outside the nav hierarchy. --- ### Sprint 3 — Spacing audit (wrap 22 pages in PageShell) **Pages to wrap with ``:** - `app/(app)/inbox/InboxClient.tsx` — currently no padding on PageHeader - `app/(app)/payments/page.tsx` — same - `app/(app)/appointments/page.tsx` — manual `px-6 pt-6` inline → replace with PageShell - `app/(app)/clients/page.tsx` + `ClientsPageClient` - `app/(app)/artists/page.tsx` - `app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx` - `app/(app)/projects/page.tsx` + detail page + `/new` - `app/(app)/ai-design/page.tsx` - `app/(app)/commissions/page.tsx` (redirect page — check if needed) - `app/(app)/clients/[id]/**/page.tsx` — 8 sub-routes - `app/(app)/reports/**/page.tsx` — the Analytics sub-pages - `app/(app)/artists/[id]/*` — detail pages - `app/(app)/appointments/[id]/*` — detail **Pages to wrap with ``:** - `app/(app)/calendar/*` - `app/(app)/messages/*` **Pages already correct — verify no regression:** - Today/Dashboard, Flash Events, Marketing, Locations, Consent Forms, Settings/*, /portfolio --- ### Sprint 4 — Deduplicate headers + fix drawer padding **Payments:** remove duplicate `` from: - `components/payments/tabs/TransactionsTab.tsx` - `components/payments/tabs/CommissionsTab.tsx` - `components/payments/tabs/PayrollTab.tsx` Parent `/payments/page.tsx` already renders the right PageHeader.
